remarks: Bright, updated, and move-in ready! Enjoy the privacy of your own entrance, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED! Step inside to a sun-filled, open-concept layout featuring a spacious living area and updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The generously sized bedroom offers two large walk-in closets, air conditioning, wall-to-wall carpeting, and a dedicated parking space! Ideally located just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, Stew Leonard's, and public transportation. Available July 1st. Only one month's security deposit required. Landlord prefers 2 year lease. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to enjoy easy, affordable living in a prime location!
